issue.standard_remedy: Route off-contract buying to contracted suppliers
issue.summary: 61% of category spend is off contract

plan.diagnosis: 61% of Castings category spend (USD 13,667,363 out of USD 22,403,282 total) is occurring off-contract across 9 plants, representing high-severity maverick spend in a direct material category. This indicates lack of contract enforcement controls in the ERP systems and insufficient sourcing compliance mechanisms for a critical production input.

remedy_steps.step: Conduct immediate audit across all 9 plants to identify unauthorized Castings suppliers and root causes (missing contract data, buyer non-compliance, emergency purchases, or contract gaps)
remedy_steps.owner: Category Manager - Castings with Plant Procurement Leads

remedy_steps.step: Implement hard ERP controls: create approved source lists in SAP (ME01), Oracle EBS, Dynamics 365, and NetSuite for contracted Castings suppliers only; enable source list enforcement to block PO creation for non-listed vendors
remedy_steps.owner: ERP Systems Team with Procurement IT

remedy_steps.step: Configure Coupa catalog with contracted Castings suppliers and pricing; disable free-form requisitions for Castings commodity code; require category manager approval workflow for any off-catalog requests
Launch mandatory training for plant buyers and requesters on contracted Castings suppliers, catalog usage, and escalation process for legitimate exceptions
Establish monthly maverick spend dashboard with plant-level visibility; implement buyer scorecard tied to contract compliance rate; escalate repeat offenders to plant management

plan.expected_impact: Redirecting 80% of the USD 13,667,363 maverick spend to contracted suppliers at an estimated 8-12% price reduction will yield USD 875,000 to USD 1,312,000 in annual savings.
kpis: Maverick spend as % of Castings category spend (target: <10% within 90 days)
Number of active Castings suppliers by plant (target: reduce to contracted set)
PO line item contract compliance rate (target: >90%)
Average Castings unit price variance vs. contract (target: <3%)
Exception approval cycle time (target: <48 hours for legitimate off-contract requests)
risks: Production disruption if contracted suppliers cannot meet capacity across 9 plants during transition
Buyer resistance and workflow delays if ERP controls are too restrictive without clear exception process
Contract pricing may not cover all Castings specifications currently purchased off-contract
Multi-ERP environment complexity may create inconsistent control implementation and enforcement gaps
Plant-level emergency procurement needs may require off-contract flexibility for business continuity
erp_actions: SAP: Create source lists (ME01) for contracted Castings suppliers by plant/material; set source list requirement indicator in material master (MARC-KORDB); apply posting block (LFA1-SPERR=X) to non-contracted Castings vendors
Oracle EBS: Define approved supplier list (ASL) entries for Castings items; enable ASL enforcement in purchasing options; set hold flag on non-contracted suppliers for Castings commodity
Dynamics 365: Configure trade agreements for contracted Castings suppliers; enable purchase agreement enforcement policy; set vendor status to 'On hold' for non-contracted Castings suppliers
NetSuite: Build preferred vendor lists for Castings items; enable item-vendor enforcement; update vendor records with category restrictions for non-contracted suppliers

Coupa: Restrict Castings commodity code to catalog-only ordering; configure approval routing for off-catalog Castings requisitions to category manager; suppress non-contracted suppliers from Castings search results
